    • TELEPORT_IDS

      public static final EntityKey<? extends Entity.Live.Writable, Collection<Integer>> TELEPORT_IDS
      The current teleport ids awaiting confirmation.

      When a teleport occurs, an ID is sent to the client whereby the client will send that ID back when the teleport is complete on the client side. Once the client has sent the ID back, it is removed from this list.
